newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Goldman Sachs said bullish on South African rand.
newsitem.headline: Goldman Sachs said bullish on South African rand.

text.p: U.S. investment bank Goldman Sachs has "cautiously" recommended buying the South African rand, according to the Financial Times of London.
The bank gave five reasons for its faith in the rand, the paper said.

It calculates that the currency's real value is about 4.18 to the dollar; it forecasts that high interest rates will remain in place until the middle of the year; it expects the fiscal deficit to fall for 1997/98; it tips external trade to improve in coming months, partly thanks to last year's deprecriation; and it said short-term capital inflows should boost foreign exhange reserves.
Goldman Sachs officials could not immediately be reached for comment on the newspaper report.
